sky_forge_exterior.promptBlock: A hanging black-iron citadel over molten rivers, storm ash, slag-gold fire in the clouds, and broken sky-chains.

backdrop.sky: storm ash, slag-gold fire in the clouds, and broken sky-chains
backdrop.ground: molten rivers far below the citadel
backdrop.surround: open storm around the hanging citadel

soundscape.ambience: distant molten-river roar, storm wind through hanging iron, chain creak under strain
soundscape.space: vast open air around a hanging citadel, long delayed echo

sun_well_court.promptBlock: An open basalt court around a sun-well of white-gold fire, iron floor veined with slag-gold, heat shimmer, storm sky above, no walls.

backdrop.sky: storm sky of ash and blue-black cloud
backdrop.surround: open ocean under the storm, no walls

sun_well.appearance: One low circular stone fire ring with a bowl of white-gold flame, a single object, no courtyard.

anvil_altar.appearance: One blacksmith anvil of dark forged iron, a single object, no tools and no workshop.

throne_dais.appearance: One low rectangular stone dais with worn steps, a single platform, no throne and no room.

gate_column_l.appearance: One twisted marble column standing alone, no base building and no second column.

gate_column_r.appearance: One twisted marble column standing alone, no base building and no second column.

soundscape.ambience: deep roar of white-gold fire in the well, steady wind across open basalt, distant storm rumble
soundscape.space: wide open air with no walls, little echo

iron_collar.appearance: One thick open iron torc neck ring, a single piece of dark metal, no person and no chain.

scenes.storyBeat: The hanging citadel and burning sky establish a kingdom that can be dropped.
scenes.motion: Ash streams across the hanging citadel above molten rivers

events.text: sky-chains groan under the hanging weight
wind tears ash across the hanging iron

scenes.storyBeat: The sun-well is shown as a killing machine before anyone speaks.
scenes.motion: White-gold fire stands in the well like a blade, flickering

events.text: the fire surges upward with a deep furnace boom and rising crackle

scenes.storyBeat: The condemned bride is seen before she is allowed a voice.

sela.action: stands silent; she slowly lifts her chin and her jaw tightens, her gaze steady
sela.expression: fear held under hard defiance: jaw set, brows low and level, eyes glassy but unblinking, lips pressed together

events.text: the iron collar creaks softly as she lifts her chin

scenes.storyBeat: The well proves it can unmake a body, so the threat is physical.
scenes.motion: A column of white fire punches from the well into the storm

events.text: a column of fire punches upward with a roaring blast and crackling heat

scenes.storyBeat: The outsider and the last prince are spatially trapped in front of the priesthood.

sela.action: stands close beside him, braced, shoulders tight

tomas.action: stands at her side, chest heaving, hands loose at his sides

vardan.action: holds the center of the priests' line, armor shifting as he settles his weight

nira.action: holds the line, shifting her stance on the iron floor

rhel.action: stands motionless at the end of the line, head high

events.text: armor plates shift
boots grind on slag-gold iron

scenes.storyBeat: The high priest sentences her in front of his wall of rank.

vardan.action: stands rigid at the center of the line and speaks without moving his body

dialogue.line: The sun-well takes a false bride tonight.
dialogue.delivery: low, ceremonial, cruel; still face, merciless articulation

events.text: armor settles as he holds still in the wind

scenes.storyBeat: The prince is forced to answer while still standing in the priest's eyeline.

tomas.action: stands rigid, jaw locked, nostrils flaring under the priest's stare, coat whipping in the wind

vardan.action: stands motionless, waiting, eyes fixed on him
vardan.expression: cold patience: lids half lowered, mouth a flat line lifting faintly at one corner in contempt

events.text: torn coat fabric flutters in the well wind

scenes.storyBeat: Tomas claims her house is still alive, which is treason if he is wrong.

tomas.action: leans toward the priests, urgent, chest heaving

sela.action: stands still, listening, her gaze held straight ahead

dialogue.line: She is the last Voss. You cannot burn a living house.

events.text: coat cloth rustles with his urgent breath

scenes.storyBeat: The priesthood answers the claim with a hand, not a debate.

kesh.action: slowly closes his armored gauntlet into a fist at chest height; his body stays motionless
kesh.expression: flat, dutiful contempt: eyes hooded, mouth a thin hard line

events.text: the gauntlet closes with a heavy iron clack

scenes.storyBeat: The marshal erases House Voss in public so the well can take her.

nira.action: stands at the front of the line, chin lifted in scorn

vardan.action: stands behind her as part of the wall, motionless

kesh.action: stands behind her as part of the wall, armor creaking as he shifts

rhel.action: stands behind her as part of the wall, motionless

dialogue.line: House Voss died with the old emperor.

events.text: plate armor creaks in the line behind her

scenes.storyBeat: Sela walks toward the machine that is supposed to kill her.

sela.action: walks forward at a steady, unhurried pace, the wrap swaying against her legs with each step

events.text: bare feet strike the iron floor in soft steps
wrap cloth brushes her legs

scenes.storyBeat: The well answers her blood before she speaks.

sela.action: holds perfectly still and does not blink; she swallows once, the collar shifting at her throat
sela.expression: wary wonder: eyes wide and unblinking, brows lifting, lips still

scenes.motion: Forge-gold light flickers across her eyes

events.text: the iron collar scrapes faintly as she swallows

scenes.storyBeat: She turns the sentence back on the priesthood.

vardan.expression: rigid disbelief: brows drawn together, jaw clenched

sela.action: holds her ground, chin level, eyes locked on him
sela.expression: calm certainty: level unblinking gaze, jaw quietly set

dialogue.line: Then the well will refuse you.
dialogue.delivery: low, final; quiet, certain, no blink

events.text: the iron collar ticks as she holds her ground

scenes.storyBeat: The fire fails to take her, so the machine has chosen.

sela.action: stands motionless in the fire, the wrap hem stirring in the heat

scenes.motion: White-gold flames lick around her bare feet

events.text: fire hisses and pops around bare feet without burning

scenes.storyBeat: Vardan names the political cost of a well that will not kill her.

vardan.action: bares his teeth as he speaks, precise
vardan.expression: fury breaking through ceremony: brows crushed down, nostrils flared, lips pulled back from bared teeth

dialogue.line: If it spares her, it names her empress.

events.text: breath tears through clenched teeth over still armor

scenes.storyBeat: The wall of rank breaks, proving they believed the well would obey them.

vardan.action: flinches back half a step with the others, then freezes, staring in shock

nira.action: flinches back half a step with the others, then freezes, staring in shock

kesh.action: flinches back half a step with the others, then freezes, staring in shock

rhel.action: flinches back half a step with the others, then freezes, staring in shock

events.text: armor plates clatter as the priests flinch together

scenes.storyBeat: She offers them the same death they wrote for her.

sela.action: holds still as the glowing collar pulses at her throat; the corners of her mouth lift toward a smile
sela.expression: cold, lethal calm: steady unblinking eyes, the corners of her mouth lifting toward a smile

dialogue.delivery: soft, lethal; almost a smile, no shout

events.text: the glowing collar hums with a low slag-gold vibration

scenes.storyBeat: The last prince realizes he crowned her by defending her.

tomas.action: stands frozen, staring; his chest jerks as his lips part on a sharp caught breath, and his face slowly opens from shock into awe
tomas.expression: shock breaking into awe: eyes widening, brows lifting, lips parting

events.text: coat fabric settles as his breath catches

scenes.storyBeat: The citadel's chains fail, so her claim can drop the kingdom.
scenes.motion: Sky-chains above the citadel snap, throwing gold sparks into the storm

events.text: sky-chains snap with sharp metal cracks and gold sparks hiss into the storm
